insights.name: Product interaction attempts
insights.description: Unique started attempts by environment, surface, journey, and action over 30 days.
insights.query: SELECT properties.environment AS environment, properties.surface AS surface, properties.journey AS journey, properties.action AS action, uniq(properties.attempt_id) AS attempts, uniq(distinct_id) AS profiles FROM events WHERE event = 'product_event' AND properties.phase = 'started' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY environment, surface, journey, action ORDER BY attempts DESC

insights.name: Product terminal outcomes
insights.description: Finished attempts split by result, action, surface, and environment over 30 days.
insights.query: SELECT properties.environment AS environment, properties.surface AS surface, properties.action AS action, properties.result AS result, uniq(properties.attempt_id) AS attempts FROM events WHERE event = 'product_event' AND properties.phase = 'finished' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY environment, surface, action, result ORDER BY attempts DESC

insights.name: Product completion, failure, and abandonment
insights.description: Started-at cohort older than 10 minutes, matched by attempt ID. Shows sample size beside completion, hard-failure, and missing-terminal rates.
insights.query: SELECT environment, surface, journey, action, count() AS starts, countIf(terminal_result != '') AS finished, countIf(terminal_result IN ('retryable_failure','terminal_failure','unknown_commit')) AS hard_failures, countIf(terminal_result = '') AS missing_terminal, if(starts = 0, 0, finished / starts) AS completion_rate, if(starts = 0, 0, hard_failures / starts) AS hard_failure_rate, if(starts = 0, 0, missing_terminal / starts) AS abandonment_rate FROM (SELECT properties.attempt_id AS attempt_id, anyIf(properties.environment, properties.phase = 'started') AS environment, anyIf(properties.surface, properties.phase = 'started') AS surface, anyIf(properties.journey, properties.phase = 'started') AS journey, anyIf(properties.action, properties.phase = 'started') AS action, argMaxIf(properties.result, timestamp, properties.phase = 'finished') AS terminal_result FROM events WHERE event = 'product_event' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND timestamp < now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE GROUP BY attempt_id HAVING countIf(properties.phase = 'started') > 0) GROUP BY environment, surface, journey, action ORDER BY starts DESC

insights.name: Product journey stopping points
insights.description: Last observed stage and phase per attempt, grouped to show where users stop.
insights.query: SELECT journey, action, surface, last_stage, last_phase, last_result, count() AS attempts FROM (SELECT properties.attempt_id AS attempt_id, any(properties.journey) AS journey, any(properties.action) AS action, any(properties.surface) AS surface, argMax(properties.stage, timestamp) AS last_stage, argMax(properties.phase, timestamp) AS last_phase, argMax(properties.result, timestamp) AS last_result FROM events WHERE event = 'product_event' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY attempt_id) GROUP BY journey, action, surface, last_stage, last_phase, last_result ORDER BY attempts DESC

insights.name: Product failures by stage and release
insights.description: Closed failure classes by action, stage, environment, and version over 30 days.
insights.query: SELECT properties.environment AS environment, properties.version AS version, properties.action AS action, properties.stage AS stage, properties.failure_kind AS failure_kind, uniq(properties.attempt_id) AS failures, uniq(distinct_id) AS impacted_profiles FROM events WHERE event = 'product_event' AND properties.phase = 'finished' AND properties.result IN ('blocked','retryable_failure','terminal_failure','unknown_commit') AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY environment, version, action, stage, failure_kind ORDER BY failures DESC

insights.name: Product terminal latency
insights.description: Median and p95 elapsed time by action, result, surface, and environment, with sample size.
insights.query: SELECT properties.environment AS environment, properties.surface AS surface, properties.action AS action, properties.result AS result, quantile(0.5)(toFloat(properties.duration_ms)) AS p50_ms, quantile(0.95)(toFloat(properties.duration_ms)) AS p95_ms, uniq(properties.attempt_id) AS outcomes FROM events WHERE event = 'product_event' AND properties.phase = 'finished' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY environment, surface, action, result ORDER BY p95_ms DESC

insights.name: Startup readiness and failure stage
insights.description: Product-ready attempts and terminal results by environment, version, and last stage.
insights.query: SELECT properties.environment AS environment, properties.version AS version, properties.phase AS phase, properties.stage AS stage, properties.result AS result, uniq(properties.attempt_id) AS attempts, quantileIf(0.95)(toFloat(properties.duration_ms), properties.phase = 'finished') AS p95_ms FROM events WHERE event = 'product_event' AND properties.action = 'product_ready' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY environment, version, phase, stage, result ORDER BY attempts DESC

insights.name: CLI command health
insights.description: Current CLI command volume and coarse exits by version over 30 days; account lifecycle remains in Account health.
insights.query: SELECT properties.version AS version, properties.command AS command, properties.subcommand AS subcommand, properties.exit AS exit, count() AS runs, uniq(distinct_id) AS profiles, quantile(0.95)(toFloat(properties.duration_ms)) AS p95_ms FROM events WHERE event = 'cli_command_run' AND properties.environment = 'cli' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY version, command, subcommand, exit ORDER BY runs DESC
